<svg viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky_grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#020513"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#0a1536"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a2c5b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tarmac_grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#080c17"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#101524"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="glow_intense">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="8" result="coloredBlur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="coloredBlur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <g id="darkening_sky">
    <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#sky_grad)"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="150" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.4"/>
    <circle cx="850" cy="90" r="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.6"/>
    <circle cx="1400" cy="200" r="1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.3"/>
    <circle cx="1700" cy="120" r="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.5"/>
    <circle cx="1100" cy="250" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.2"/>
    <path d="M-100,500 Q200,450 400,520 T900,480 T1500,550 T2000,490 L2000,650 L-100,650 Z" fill="#111b33" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M200,550 Q500,510 800,560 T1400,530 T1920,580 L1920,650 L200,650 Z" fill="#0d1428" opacity="0.8"/>
    <path d="M100,300 Q300,280 500,320 T900,300 Q1100,290 1300,330 T1800,310" stroke="#162447" stroke-width="25" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.4" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <g id="runway_surface">
    <rect x="0" y="650" width="1920" height="430" fill="url(#tarmac_grad)"/>
    <polygon points="1200,650 1300,650 1920,1080 300,1080" fill="#0b101c"/>
    <polygon points="1190,655 1205,655 1250,1080 1150,1080" fill="#131a2b"/>
    <path d="M1250,650 L1100,1080" stroke="#d3d9e3" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="40 60" opacity="0.3"/>
    <path d="M1200,650 L300,1080" stroke="#8a95a5" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.2"/>
    <path d="M1300,650 L1920,1080" stroke="#8a95a5" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.2"/>
    <polygon points="450,1050 500,1050 550,1080 480,1080" fill="#d3d9e3" opacity="0.2"/>
    <polygon points="550,1050 600,1050 670,1080 600,1080" fill="#d3d9e3" opacity="0.2"/>
    <polygon points="650,1050 700,1050 790,1080 720,1080" fill="#d3d9e3" opacity="0.2"/>
    <polygon points="750,1050 800,1050 910,1080 840,1080" fill="#d3d9e3" opacity="0.2"/>
    <path d="M720,830 L1560,830" stroke="#ffb703" stroke-width="6" opacity="0.4"/>
    <path d="M700,850 L1590,850" stroke="#ffb703" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="30 20" opacity="0.4"/>
  </g>

  <g id="terminal_building">
    <polygon points="1350,650 1350,550 1800,530 1800,650" fill="#060912"/>
    <polygon points="1800,530 1920,540 1920,650 1800,650" fill="#04060d"/>
    <polygon points="1330,550 1350,540 1810,520 1810,530" fill="#121b2b"/>
    <polygon points="1000,650 1000,600 1200,620 1200,650" fill="#05080f"/>
    <g fill="#ffb703" filter="url(#glow)" opacity="0.9">
      <rect x="1400" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1460" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1520" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1580" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1640" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
      <rect x="1700" y="570" width="35" height="25" rx="2"/>
    </g>
    <g fill="#fb8500" filter="url(#glow)" opacity="0.7">
      <rect x="1400" y="610" width="35" height="15" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="1520" y="610" width="35" height="15" rx="1"/>
      <rect x="1640" y="610" width="35" height="15" rx="1"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="1380" cy="540" r="3.5" fill="#ff0000" filter="url(#glow)"/>
  </g>

  <g id="airport_details">

    <circle cx="1440" cy="650" r="3" fill="#000000"/>

    <circle cx="1265" cy="650" r="4" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="1315" cy="650" r="4" fill="#000000"/>

    <circle cx="1160" cy="550" r="2.5" fill="#ffb703" filter="url(#glow)"/>
    <path d="M1500,650 L1500,530 M1480,530 L1520,530" stroke="#050812" stroke-width="3"/>

    <circle cx="1520" cy="530" r="2.5" fill="#ffffff" filter="url(#glow)"/>

    <path d="M1850,1080 Q1860,1050 1880,1040 M1870,1080 Q1880,1030 1900,1040 M1900,1080 Q1910,1060 1920,1050" stroke="#050812" stroke-width="4" fill="none"/>
  </g>

  <g id="control_tower">
    <polygon points="500,1080 200,1080 320,900" fill="#050812" opacity="0.8"/>
    <polygon points="250,1080 220,250 380,250 500,1080" fill="#070b14"/>
    <polygon points="250,1080 220,250 280,250 350,1080" fill="#0c1321"/>
    <polygon points="225,400 375,400 377,420 226,420" fill="#04060a"/>
    <polygon points="235,700 425,700 430,730 238,730" fill="#04060a"/>
    <polygon points="200,250 400,250 450,180 150,180" fill="#0f1726"/>
    <polygon points="150,180 450,180 460,160 140,160" fill="#162136"/>
    <polygon points="160,160 440,160 410,70 190,70" fill="#ffb703" opacity="0.75" filter="url(#glow_intense)"/>
    <polygon points="200,160 220,80 250,80 250,160" fill="#fb8500" opacity="0.6"/>
    <polygon points="350,160 350,90 380,90 390,160" fill="#fb8500" opacity="0.6"/>
    <polygon points="280,160 280,100 320,100 320,160" fill="#b7410e" opacity="0.5"/>
    <path d="M160,160 L190,70 M440,160 L410,70 M250,160 L260,70 M350,160 L340,70" stroke="#060912" stroke-width="10"/>
    <polygon points="180,70 420,70 400,40 200,40" fill="#0a0f1c"/>
    <rect x="290" y="20" width="20" height="20" fill="#0f1726"/>
    <path d="M300,20 L300,-30 M280,-10 L320,-10 M290,0 L310,0" stroke="#0f1726" stroke-width="5"/>
    <path d="M220,40 Q240,10 260,40 Z" fill="#162136"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="-30" r="6" fill="#ff0000" filter="url(#glow_intense)"/>
  </g>

  <g id="runway_lights">
    <g filter="url(#glow)">
      <ellipse cx="1150" cy="670" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1100" cy="690" rx="4.5" ry="2" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1020" cy="720" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="910" cy="765" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="760" cy="830" rx="11" ry="5.5" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="580" cy="910" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="360" cy="1010" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#ffb703"/>
      
      <ellipse cx="1320" cy="670" rx="3" ry="1.5" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1350" cy="690" rx="4.5" ry="2" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1400" cy="720" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1470" cy="765" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1560" cy="830" rx="11" ry="5.5" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1680" cy="910" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#ffb703"/>
      <ellipse cx="1840" cy="1010" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#ffb703"/>
      
      <ellipse cx="1210" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
      <ellipse cx="1225" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
      <ellipse cx="1240" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
      <ellipse cx="1255" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
      <ellipse cx="1270" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
      <ellipse cx="1285" cy="655" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fb8500"/>
    </g>
    <g filter="url(#glow_intense)">
      <ellipse cx="760" cy="830" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="580" cy="910" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
      <ellipse cx="360" cy="1010" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="1"/>
      <ellipse cx="1560" cy="830" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.7"/>
      <ellipse cx="1680" cy="910" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
      <ellipse cx="1840" cy="1010" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="1"/>

</svg>
notes: Le moment capture le calme et la grandeur de l'aéroport fonctionnel à la tombée de la nuit, le contraste entre l'immensité sombre et les repères lumineux chaleureux créant une atmosphère d'attente. L'animation des 'runway_lights' (allumage progressif ou clignotement) et de la cabine de la 'control_tower' sera parfaite pour instiller une tension silencieuse juste avant l'événement brutal.
